intuition: The lowest common ancestor is the first node whose subtree contains both target nodes, including the case where one target is that node.

brute_force.approach: For each node, search both subtrees for both targets and keep the deepest node containing them.

optimal.approach: Return a target when found, combine non-null results from both children, and otherwise propagate the one found result upward.

edge_cases: The ancestor may be one of the target nodes.
Targets can lie in separate child subtrees.
The test must pass the actual nodes from the constructed tree.
